# Array inputs with mapped carrier results

Independently authored array and Function inputs bind distinct Object method
formals; an invariant Set result retains the output formal. The provider returns
an opaque late-selected set and need not construct a collection from the mapper.
An ordinary nongeneric superclass and an inherited static facade keep declaration
ownership separate from the original array and callback values.

Source and SDK profiles compile every emitted Java8 unit, compare original roles,
Signatures and Exceptions, and repeat 132 fresh-JVM cases twice. Frozen observers
check array identity and covariance, read/store snapshots, late index and global
changes, callback order, opaque result casts, ignored calls and exact failures.
Independent wrong programs precede recovery; metadata controls preserve Code.
